caption:
India finds second unsafe Bisleri water sample, this time with bacteria

A regulatory document shows the sample contained coliform bacteria. Bisleri is India's biggest packaged-water brand, and its 20-US cent bottles have made it a household name. Poor water quality has made bottled water a necessity for homes and restaurants across India. Bisleri competes with PepsiCo and Coca-Cola and has stayed the market leader.

Reported by CNA; South China Morning Post; The Straits Times.
